local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wizard"))()

local Window = Library:NewWindow("Prisoner Life")
local Section = Window:NewSection("Main")

-- store original states
local stored = {}

local function setState(parent, enabled)
    if not parent then return end

    for _, obj in pairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            if enabled then
                -- save original
                if not stored[obj] then
                    stored[obj] = {
                        Transparency = obj.Transparency,
                        CanCollide = obj.CanCollide
                    }
                end

                obj.Transparency = 0.8
                obj.CanCollide = false
            else
                -- restore original
                if stored[obj] then
                    obj.Transparency = stored[obj].Transparency
                    obj.CanCollide = stored[obj].CanCollide
                    stored[obj] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

Section:CreateToggle("Remove DoorsToilets", function(value)
    local doors = workspace:FindFirstChild("NewDoors")
    local breakables = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS") and workspace.Prison_ITEMS:FindFirstChild("breakables")

    setState(doors, value)
    setState(breakables, value)
end)

Section:CreateButton("Instant Proximity", function()
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Instantly-interact-with-proximity-prompt-73901"))()
end)

Section:CreateButton("Nameless admin", function()
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Nameless-admin-reworked-75477"))()
end)
